meaning.en: now, next
of renunciants who seek liberation
the Kutichaka, Bahudaka, Hamsa, and Paramahamsa (the four stages of renunciation)
four (in number)
those called Kutichaka
in the line of Gautama, Bharadvaja, Yajnavalkya, Vasishtha and others
meaning.hi: गौतम, भरद्वाज, याज्ञवल्क्य, वसिष्ठ आदि की परंपरा में

meaning.en: taking eight mouthfuls as alms
seek only liberation, through the path of yoga
meaning.hi: योगमार्ग से केवल मोक्ष चाहते हैं

meaning.en: those called Bahudaka
carrying the triple staff, water pot, and topknot
meaning.hi: त्रिदंड, कमंडल और शिखा धारण करते

meaning.en: wearing the sacred thread and ochre robes
avoiding honey and meat in the homes of the learned
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मर्षियों के घर में मधु-मांस त्यागकर

meaning.en: taking eight mouthfuls gathered as alms
seek only liberation through yoga
meaning.hi: योगमार्ग से केवल मोक्ष चाहते हैं

meaning.en: those called Hamsa
one night in a village
five nights in a town
seven nights in a larger place
should not stay beyond

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: living on cow urine and cow dung
meaning.hi: गोमूत्र और गोमय का आहार करते हुए

meaning.en: constantly devoted to the lunar chandrayana fast
seek only liberation through yoga
meaning.hi: योगमार्ग से केवल मोक्ष चाहते हैं

meaning.en: those called Paramahamsa
in the line of the compassionate ones, Aruni, Shvetaketu, Jada Bharata, Dattatreya, Shuka, Vamadeva, Haritaka and others
meaning.hi: करुणामय, अरुणि, श्वेतकेतु, जड़भरत, दत्तात्रेय, शुक, वामदेव, हारीतक आदि की परंपरा में

meaning.en: taking eight mouthfuls as alms
seek only liberation through yoga
meaning.hi: योगमार्ग से केवल मोक्ष चाहते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: dwelling at tree roots, in empty houses, or cremation grounds
meaning.hi: वृक्षमूल, शून्यगृह या श्मशान में निवास करते हुए

meaning.en: whether lightly clothed or unclothed
for them there is no right and wrong
meaning.hi: उनके लिए न धर्म न अधर्म

meaning.en: no gain and loss, no pure and impure
free of every such duality
treating clod of earth, stone, and gold as the same
meaning.hi: मिट्टी, पत्थर और सोने को समान मानते

meaning.en: begging for food among people of every rank
they see nothing anywhere but the self
meaning.hi: हर जगह केवल आत्मा को ही देखते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: wearing only what nature gave them
meaning.hi: जन्म के समान रूप धारण किए

meaning.en: free of conflict, owning nothing
fixed in bright meditation, established in the self
taking alms at the proper hour, only enough to keep the breath going
meaning.hi: प्राण-धारण हेतु यथोक्त समय पर भिक्षा लेते हुए

meaning.en: in empty rooms, temples, straw heaps, anthills, tree roots, potters' sheds, fire-halls, riverbanks, mountain caves, hollows and waterfalls
meaning.hi: खाली कक्ष, मंदिर, तृणकूट, वल्मीक, वृक्षमूल, कुम्हारशाला, अग्निहोत्रशाला, नदीतट, गिरिकंदरा, कोटर और झरनों में

meaning.en: settled rightly on the path to Brahman, with a clear mind
meaning.hi: ब्रह्ममार्ग में सम्यक् संपन्न, शुद्ध मन वाले

meaning.en: living as true Paramahamsas, let go of the body through renunciation
meaning.hi: परमहंस आचरण से संन्यास द्वारा देह त्यागते हैं

meaning.en: such are the ones called Paramahamsas; so says this Upanishad
meaning.hi: वे ही परमहंस कहलाते हैं, यह उपनिषद है
